question: My dog weighs 35 kilos and shreds everything. Which rope toy should I buy?
answer:
For your 35-kilo dog that shreds everything, I recommend the following rope toys:

1. **Tug Titan Rope (WW-D-101)**: 
   - Made from thick, double-braided organic cotton.
   - Size: Extra Large (XL) recommended for dogs over 30 kg.
   - Chew rating: 3 Strong.
   - Price: $26.

2. **Ultra Chew Ring (WW-D-109)**:
   - Made from reinforced natural rubber.
   - Size: Large.
   - Chew rating: 4 Power (Built Tough), suitable for strong chewers.
   - Price: $28.

Both options are designed for larger dogs and have higher chew ratings suitable for determined chewers. (Source: Section 3)

Section 3. Product Catalogue > Tug Titan Rope (WW-D-101)
The Tug Titan is the toy that started Wag & Whisker. It is made from thick, double-braided
organic cotton with knotted ends that give dogs a firm grip for tug-of-war. The tight braid
also works like dental floss as dogs chew.
• Materials: double-braided organic cotton
• Sizes and prices: Medium $18, Large $22, Extra Large (XL) $26
• Chew rating: 3 Strong
• Size guidance: choose XL for dogs over 30 kg
• Care: machine-wash cold and air dry

Section 3. Product Catalogue > Twisty Rope Ring (WW-D-102)
A lighter rope toy shaped into a ring, ideal for fetch and gentle tugging. The single twist is
softer on young and small mouths but isn't designed for heavy chewing.
• Materials: single-twist cotton–jute blend
• Size: one size
• Price: $12
• Chew rating: 2 Moderate
• Weight guidance: suitable for dogs up to 20 kg
• Not suitable for power chewers

Section 2. Safety Standards
• 2 Moderate: for light chewing and tugging. Most dogs who play nicely fall here.
• 3 Strong: for determined chewers who work at a toy until something gives.
• 4 Power: our "Built Tough" line, for dogs that destroy most toys. These toys use our
densest rubber and thickest walls.
Cat and small-pet toys don't carry chew ratings, because cats and small pets play in very
different ways. Instead, each product lists the animals and ages it suits.
Supervision
No toy is indestructible. Always supervise play, check toys regularly, and replace any toy that
shows cracks, loose threads, missing pieces or deep tooth marks. Remove a toy straight away
if a piece comes off.
Choosing the right toy
The right toy depends on three things: your pet's size, how they play, and how much
supervision you can give.
For dogs, start with the chew rating. If your dog has destroyed toys before, look at ratings 3
and 4. If your dog mostly carries toys around or plays gently, ratings 1 and 2 will feel more

• Materials: reinforced natural rubber
